title: contracts/design-review.json
description: The end-of-build design review plan read by design-review-workflow's check-review-plan.mjs, new-review.mjs, check-review.mjs and check-signoff.mjs. Paths are repo-relative. The checkers also prove what a schema cannot: the plan against the app config, the languages, the screen contract, the motion catalog and the debug-link contract.

reviewsDir.description: Where review records live, one folder per review (committed). Default design-review.

capturesDir.description: Where captures live, <capturesDir>/<review-id>/cells and /motion (git-ignored). Default reports/design-review.

contract.description: The screen contract (screen-contracts). Default contracts/screens.json. Every screen and state is swept except embedded parts and the exclusions.

exclude.description: Screens a person never sees in a shipped build (a test-only screen), each with why.

open.description: How each swept state is opened: "<screen>.<state>" -> a debug-link query without lang/theme/motion ("open=tasks"), or an app path ("/tasks/42").

invariant.description: A screen that cannot change along an axis (a canvas with no text across locales), so identical captures there are expected.

locales.description: One left-to-right and, when the app ships one, one right-to-left locale.

textSizes.description: default (iOS large, Android 1) on every device and largest (iOS accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large, Android 2) on at least every smallest phone.

devices.description: Sweep this size only on these device ids (default: every device).

name.description: The simulator or emulator this review creates and owns, <project>-<purpose>; never booted or a shared one.

size.description: The capture size in pixels [width, height], when known.

record.description: Moments recorded as video, full and reduced motion, per platform.

variant.description: The preview build: Release JavaScript that keeps the test-only debug link every combination is set through (language, theme, motion held still). Production builds strip it; the store build is judged in the on-device pass.

signoff.description: Optional changes to the paths check-signoff.mjs treats as user-facing after the signed commit. Globs on repo paths: * stays inside a folder, ** crosses folders, a trailing / means the whole folder.

watch.description: Extra user-facing paths (native/, a second entry file, a shared design folder).

ignore.description: Watched paths that never change what people see (a dev-only tool folder), each a deliberate choice.

hardware.description: Real phones, one per shipped platform at least: the cheapest of the target market.

steps.description: Every core step, destructive ones last; an app may add its own.
